title: quercus faginea var. pedunculata
intro: Quercus faginea var. pedunculata, commonly known as the Pedunculate Oak, is a variety of the Faginea Oak tree, characterized by its unique pedunculate (stalked) acorns. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to support overall health and well-being, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Quercus faginea var. pedunculata include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, tannins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
